subject: Life Skills
title: Recognizing Manipulation Tactics
description: A micro-lesson that makes Recognizing Manipulation Tactics usable.

hook.text: Every time she set a boundary, he said 'I guess you just do not care about me.' She caved every time.

buildup.text: Guilt-tripping is emotional manipulation. It reframes your healthy choice as proof that you are a bad person.

discovery.text: Common tactics: guilt-tripping, gaslighting, silent treatment, love-bombing.

twist.text: Manipulators often do not see themselves as manipulators. The behavior can be learned and unconscious.

climax.text: Name the tactic when you see it — even just to yourself. 'That is guilt-tripping' breaks its power over your emotions.

punchline.text: Label it and the spell breaks.

quiz.question: Why does naming a manipulation tactic help?
options: It embarrasses the manipulator into stopping
It separates the tactic from your emotional response, breaking its power
It proves the other person is intentionally harmful
